_comment: All lengths in metres, times in seconds, speeds in m/s. Every parameter carries a 'source'. 'assumption' means the value was chosen for this project and is NOT taken from a verified standard.

sources.DAIDALUS: NASA DAIDALUS v2.0.4a, Configurations/DO_365B_no_SUM.conf, github.com/nasa/daidalus commit 1c7b58e5525d5cca91cbbf4a8b7337a488243769 (fetched 2026-09-28). This is NASA's open-source reference implementation of the RTCA DO-365 DAA alerting logic; the DO-365 document itself was not read.
sources.DAIDALUS_SRC: Same commit, Java/src/gov/nasa/larcfm/ACCoRD/WCV_TAUMOD.java and WCV_tvar.java (well-clear violation test and interval computation).
sources.CFR_91_113: 14 CFR 91.113(e)-(f), eCFR, fetched 2026-09-28: head-on -> each pilot alters course to the right; overtaking aircraft alters course to the right.
sources.VERTIFLITE_DIR: J. Meszaros, 'Chinese eVTOL Aircraft Directory, Part 1', evtol.news (Vertical Flight Society), 2 May 2025, https://evtol.news/news/chinese-evtol-aircraft-directory-part-1 (fetched 2026-09-28).

well_clear.source: DAIDALUS: DWC_Non_Coop det_2 (2200 ft, 450 ft, TTHR 0 s). Used here as the loss-of-well-clear volume for low-altitude encounters; that it suits eVTOL traffic is an assumption.

wcv.source: DAIDALUS: DTHR/TTHR from DWC_Non_Coop; corrective/warning alerting times 55 s / 25 s from DWC_Non_Coop alert_2/alert_3; preventive ZTHR 700 ft taken from DWC_Phase_I alert_1 (mixing Phase I preventive ZTHR with Non-Coop DTHR is an assumption).

wcv_tau.source: assumption: a modified-tau buffer of 20 s added to the WCV detector (DAIDALUS Phase I uses 35 s with DTHR 0.66 nmi; 20 s is not from any source).

cpa.source: assumption: CPA-threshold logic designed for this project; thresholds deliberately set equal to the WCV strategy so that the comparison isolates the logic, not the numbers.

persistence_m_of_n.source: DAIDALUS: alerting_m = 2, alerting_n = 4 (used only as a sensitivity row)

required_lead_time.source: assumption: an alert counts as timely only if it precedes loss of well clear by at least 25 s (chosen equal to the warning alerting time).

response_delay.source: assumption: time from corrective alert to manoeuvre start

plan_buffer.source: assumption: planner requires 1.2x the well-clear distances on the predicted track

floor_m.source: assumption: minimum altitude above terrain/obstacles for the ownship

ceiling_m.source: assumption: upper edge of the low-altitude layer

right_turn_preference.source: CFR_91_113 (tie-break only: among equally small conflict-free turns, prefer the right turn)

encounter.source: assumption: synthetic encounter distribution, not fitted to any traffic data

intruder_manoeuvre.source: assumption: 20% of intruders make an unannounced heading change of 30-90 deg, 10-60 s before the nominal CPA

performance._source: assumption: representative values for illustration, not the data of any specific aircraft. Turn rate is derived from the bank limit: omega = g*tan(bank)/V.

evtol.speed_source: Range 55-70 m/s (198-252 km/h) chosen inside the 200-300 km/h cruise speeds quoted for Chinese passenger eVTOL designs in VERTIFLITE_DIR (e.g. 200, 230, 240 and 300 km/h entries); the exact range is an assumption.

performance.a_z_note: a_z = 0.25 g equals DAIDALUS vertical_accel; a_x = 2 m/s^2 equals DAIDALUS horizontal_accel. Applying them to an eVTOL is an assumption.

sensors._source: assumption: illustrative surveillance error levels, not from any equipment specification
sensors.dropout_model: Gilbert two-state: p_gb = P(good->lost), p_bg = P(lost->good) per 1 s update
sensors.tracker: alpha-beta filter per axis; gains from the steady-state relations for tracking index lambda = sigma_a*dt^2/sigma_n, where sigma_a = gust_sigma*sqrt(2/gust_tau) of the intruder type and sigma_n the sensor sigma (assumption: the tracker knows the true noise levels)
